sampling.weight_scope: Architectural operation occurrences under a declared synthetic workload mixture; not observed serving traffic
sampling.selection_scope: Shape-only design. Latency labels and prediction errors do not determine split membership or the repeat subset.
sampling.repeat_scope: 77 shapes selected before measurement using split, M regime, and alignment strata; measured later on the same physical GPU/session.
sampling.rotation_scope: Four-buffer working-set sensitivity for eligible weights up to twice the observed L2 size; not proof of cold-cache execution.

quality.interpretation: All flagged rows remain in the results. Passing record-consistency checks is separate from passing every timing-quality threshold.

measurement.execution: preallocated torch.mm(X, W.T, out=Y), inference mode, autocast disabled
measurement.aggregation: Median of 3 visit medians; each visit uses 9 graph-replay samples normalized by that visit's captured GEMM count.
measurement.included: CUDA-event graph-replay elapsed time, including resident GPU memory accesses and device-side replay/inter-kernel gaps, divided by the captured GEMM count.
measurement.excluded: Allocation, CPU-GPU transfer, graph capture, warmup, reference checks, profiling, fitting, backup-copy intervals, full decoder, and serving queues.

selection.method: Six-fold grouped cross-validation on training N,K families only; fold-local preprocessing and fitting, followed by refitting on all training rows.
selection.primary_score: Pooled out-of-fold weighted mean APE; weighted P90 and then fixed model order break ties.
selection.cv_score_scope: Training model-selection evidence; not an unbiased final-test performance estimate.

metric_definitions.weighted_mean_ape_pct: Sum of weight * APE divided by the sum of weights; declared architectural occurrence weights, not traffic weights or WAPE.
metric_definitions.mean_ape_pct: Unweighted arithmetic mean of per-shape APE.
metric_definitions.p90_ape_pct: Unweighted 90th percentile of per-shape APE, using linear interpolation.
metric_definitions.worst_ape_pct: Maximum observed per-shape APE in this evaluation subset; not a future error bound.

limitations: One A100 hardware/software configuration and one session with a later subset repeat; no cross-day or cross-device replication.
Cache contexts use separately fitted models and partly different eligible cohorts; their errors do not isolate a causal cache effect.
Six primary rows and one repeat control group fail declared timing thresholds. The overall quality flag is false; all rows are retained.
Matrix dimensions come from five pinned architecture configurations, not observed production traffic or full pretrained-model execution.
No hardware counters establish cache-hit rates, bandwidth saturation, or Tensor Core utilization.
The optional decoder-layer experiment was not requested. Per-GEMM prediction error is not full-model latency, serving performance, or a GPU speedup.
